# Local font provenance

These are the existing site’s font families, hosted locally to remove third-party requests. The font files are unmodified. Fira files come from this repository at commit `711ade383a5eaaa3becb11b41370039334792d15`. Raleway is the regular font returned by the original Google Fonts import on 2026-09-19. Font Awesome and Academicons preserve the existing icon glyphs.

Licenses are included beside the fonts. Only the few required icon CSS declarations are retained.
